question: Which one of the following States will be directly connected with Assam by the proposed bridge between Dhubri and Phulbari over river Brahmaputra?
solution:
The correct answer is:__** Meghalaya**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• The **proposed bridge** between** Dhubri and Phulbari over river Brahmaputra i**n India will **directly connect the state of Assam with the state of Meghalaya. **
 
• **The bridge will be located near the town of Phulbari in the West Garo Hills district of Meghalaya and will connect to the town of Dhubri in the state of Assam**.
 
• The bridge is **expected to reduce travel time between the two states and promote economic development in the region.**
 
• **The project is part of the government's efforts to improve connectivity and infrastructure in the northeastern region of India.**
